texts.name: Omega
texts.biography: Omega never gave up on his eyes, even though he was blind before the transformation. But once a powerful sorcerer, he combined his eyes with electronic tools so that he could not only regain his sight, but also see things that no one else could be informed of.

specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Scouting skill.
specialty.name: Scouting
